_comment: Fallback metadata for the generated CAD parts (mechanical/out). Used only while mechanical/components/catalog.json does not exist. 'lock' refers to the row number in docs/PARTS-LOCK.md. These are generated envelope models, not vendor-accurate geometry.

bottom.name: Base shell
bottom.process: 3D print, MJF PA12 or SLA resin (spec section 2: 0.9 mm wall)
bottom.note: Carries the reservoir seat, leadscrew bearings, gear and motor pockets and the cannula dock.

top.name: Lid shell
top.process: 3D print, MJF PA12 or SLA resin
top.note: Fill window with U scale, screw bosses. Height budget 8.5 mm total.

reservoir.name: Reservoir, stadium bore 16 x 5 mm
reservoir.note: Ordered once per size, never changed. No septum, valve or needle in this part.

plunger_core.name: Plunger core
plunger_core.note: Stadium-shaped, anti-rotation feature. Carries the cast lip seal.

plunger_seal.name: Plunger lip seal
plunger_seal.process: Cast platinum-cure silicone, Shore A 40, in the printed mould
plunger_seal.note: Biggest development risk (spec section 3). Medical-grade silicone for insulin bench tests.

carriage.name: Carriage with nut pocket
carriage.note: Hex pocket for the DIN 934 M1.6 brass nut; arm pushes the plunger.

end_cap.name: End cap (septum, duckbill, needle hub)
end_cap.process: 3D print, pressed onto the reservoir port
end_cap.note: Holds the fill septum (lock 18), the duckbill check valve (lock 16) and the 30G needle (lock 17).

cannula_adapter.name: Cannula dock adapter
cannula_adapter.note: Horizontal slide-on dock for the Insight Flex head, two snap arms. Dimensions of the head are not public: fit-test coupon first.

coupler.name: Sleeve coupler (coaxial layout option)
coupler.note: Only used in the coaxial layout. The default bench layout uses the gear pair instead.
